thread:
Maya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Maya: did a pass on the kernel branch: landed prefetch throttling + added a small guard for zero-length inputs. ran microbatch smokebench (local) — p95 down ~8% on short seqs.
Maya: blocker: seeing KV cache churn on heavy prefix reuse when slot reclaim happens. reproducer attached below.
Maya: repro steps:
Maya: ```
MAYA: run bench --model=redwood-v2-small --seq=128 --clients=40 --pattern=prefix_reuse
MAYA: watch /proc/meminfo and runtime logs for repeated evict/restore cycles
Maya: ```
Aj: nice, the prefetch throttle sounds promising. can you paste the log snippet of the churn?
Maya: here's the log excerpt: `evict: slot=42 reason=slot_reclaim; restore=slot=42 latency=12ms; cache_hit=false` repeated ~6x in 30s window.
Devon: fwiw we've seen similar when slot_lease was too short and garbage collection overlapped with batch routing. did you try bumping slot_lease?
Maya: not yet — thought it might be a routing gap. bumping slot_lease to 5s from 1s in my local run reduced restores but p95 still had spikes.
Priya: pinging @Aj and @Devon re: quick CR — I left comments on PR #482 (kernel/prefetch) about slot_lease and a potential race in slot allocator. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
Aj: looking now. quick note: prefer `MAX_SLOT_LEASE_MS` env override so we can canary config without rebuild.
Devon: agree. also let's add a metric: `kv.evictions_per_minute` with slot labels so we can correlate with routing events.
Maya: adding metric + togglable env. will open small follow-up PR after this patch merges.
Priya: small ops note — staging ded-1 had a tiny deploy yesterday that bumped kernel image. sre-bot reported a transient OOM on one host during the rollout but auto-recovered.
sre-bot: [deploy] staging/ded-1 kernel-v2.3.7 deployed. 1 host failed with OOM, autoscaler removed and rejoin succeeded.
Aj: thanks. back on the KV churn — if metric shows evict spikes align with slot handoffs we can try increasing warmup window for hot prefixes instead of just slot_lease.
Maya: plan for today: (1) add evictions metric + labels, (2) add env override for slot_lease, (3) run a 30m microbatch perf run against staging with prefix_reuse pattern and collect telemetry, (4) follow-up PR for metric + env.
Maya: anyone blocking me on infra or config?
Devon: no blockers from me. I can pair later if you want to instrument the metric (I touched the telemetry path).
Aj: free after 3pm PT, can help run the staging perf.
Priya: I can reserve a slot on staging for 3:30pm PT and keep an eye on the ded pool.
Maya: awesome — thanks team. I'll push the metric PR first and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
Aj: thanks — and drop the perf run command here when ready so I can grab logs straight into the bench collector.
Maya: will do.
